name: loader
title: Loader
description: A polite status region that says in words what is loading, with a small drawing beside it: three pulsing dots in quiet, a light travelling round a kolam and lighting each dot in warm, a spinning bambaram in playful. It never claims how far along the work is.

budget.reason: The contract's 12 KB behaviour plus 8 KB per skin, declared as the sum used: behaviour (loader.js) about 3.2 KB, including the status line that announces a newly added loader once; skins about 0.9 KB (quiet), 2.9 KB (warm) and 3.3 KB (playful). The warm skin reuses the Kolam scene's geometry.
